- Sound is a **pressure wave**, that propagates through a **medium** (gas, liquid, or solid).
- **Propagation** is caused by the **oscillation** (*vibration*) of the medium's **particles**, around their *equilibrium* positions.
:::
- Sound has the following properties:
  - **Speed**: ~343m/s in air
  - **Amplitude**: measured in Pascals (Pa)
  - **Period**: time between two oscillations
  - **Wavelength**: distance between two oscillations

## Sound (physical properties) {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {.content style="padding-left: -50px;"}
::: {style="font-size: 90%;"}
::: {style="opacity: 0.5"}
- Sound is a **pressure wave**, that propagates through a **medium** (gas, liquid, or solid).
- **Propagation** is caused by the **oscillation** (*vibration*) of the medium's **particles**, around their *equilibrium* positions.
:::
- Sound has the following properties:
  - **Speed**: ~343m/s in air
  - **Amplitude**: measured in Pascals (Pa)
  - **Period**: time between two oscillations
  - **Wavelength**: distance between two oscillations
  - **Frequency**: cycles per second, in Hertz (Hz, kHz, MHz)
  - **Spectrum** (or timbre)
:::
:::
:::
::: {.column width="44%"}

<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->
## Sound perception {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

::: {.incremental}
- Our perception of sound is made from the conversion of the **vibrations** reaching our **eardrums** to a **signal of nerve impulses**, transmitted and interpreted by the brain.
- **Human ears** can typically identify sounds ranging from **20 Hz to 20 kHz**.
- Other animal hearing ranges (a little *quizzzzzz*):

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column}
- **Bat**:
  - 2 kHz to 110 kHz,
- **Porpoise**:
  - 75 Hz to 150 kHz,
- **Cat**:
  - 45 Hz to 64 kHz,
:::
:::{.column}
  - **Elephant**:
    - 5 Hz to 12 kHz
  - **Chicken**:
    - 125 Hz to 2 kHz,
  - **Owl**:
    - 100 Hz to 18 kHz,
:::
::::
:::
